patterns: Invented Monday 08–12 fracture x1.8; other weekday 08–12 x1.35; Saturday 04–12 abdominal x1.9; Sunday x1.5; Friday/Saturday late and early head/wounds x1.25. No causal evidence about bikes or alcohol.
randomness: Poisson within-block arrivals, shared-city daily 4%, local daily 5%, block 4% mean-one lognormal factors; lognormal service durations.
priority: Bed class 15 ahead of ordinary; stored bed urgency remains 10. Ordinary urgency truncated normal mean about 3, max7.5; queue aging one point per2min. Nonpreemptive.
planning: Deterministic expected weekly case-work and eligibility routing; integer rosters locally calibrated toward 105–140min fluid waits with >=1.5% weekly capacity reserve. This is target calibration, not NHS validation; only one stochastic month is run.
general_service: 20min case-mix mean direct work +15% of occupied time for documentation/other duties; total mean23.53min.
bed_support: 5% independent synthetic bed need; mean12h hold; capacity planned at65% nominal occupancy.
distribution: No sampled wait floor or forced normal waiting-time distribution. Waits emerge from queues.
